violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried rice (131°F) in the rice warmer at the front line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. REHEATED TO 165°F

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH THE EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT. STAFF ARE TO READ, ACKNOWLEDGE, AND SIGN THE FORMS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED MANAGEMENT WITH THE WRITTEN POLICY ON HOW TO CLEAN UP ANY EVENTS OF VOMITING AND/OR DIARRHEA. IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT MANAGEMENT ORDER A BODILY FLUID CLEAN UP KIT TO KEEP ON SITE AT THE FACILITY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW SEAFOOD LIKE SALMON AND TUNA STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE SAUCES INSIDE THE 2DOOR PREP TOP UNIT AT SUSHI, 2) RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED DIRECTLY ON TOP OF A 5 GALLON CONTAINER OF SAUCE INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS HAD MANAGEMENT RE-ORGANIZE THE STORAGE OF THE RAW SEAFOOD AND RAW EGGS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) OBSERVED COOKED/GRILLED CHICKEN ON THE GRIDDLE AT 114F-129F, 2) SUSHI RICE NOT DOCUMENTED FOR TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL OBSERVED AT 122F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS REQUESTED THAT THE CHICKEN EITHER BE DISCARDED OR REHEATED TO 165F. EHS REMINDED MANAGEMENT THAT ONCE THE FOODS ARE COOKED AND ARE SITTING OFF TO THE SIDE OF THE GRIDDLE, THE FOOD SHALL REMAIN AT 135F OR ABOVE. SUSHI RICE WILL BE CONTROLLED USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. AGREEMENT DOCUMENT PROVIDED IN EMAIL. STAFF ARE TO USE THE SUSHI RICE ONLY UNTIL 3PM. DISCARD IF NOT USED AT 3PM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) CUT CABBAGE IN BAGS OF MIXED VEGETABLES, 2) COOKED NOODLES.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING REQUIREMENTS WITH STAFF. SEE FACT SHEET ON DATE MARKING. ENSURE ANY PREPARED FOODS ARE LABELED AND DATED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed commercially vacuum packaged seafood being thawed under refrigeration but the bags were not cut open.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ANY COMMERCIALLY, VACUUM PACKAGED SEAFOOD SHALL HAVE THE PACKAGING CUT OPEN WHEN MOVED FROM THE FREEZER TO THE REFRIGERATOR FOR PROPER THAWING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) BULK BINS FOR CORN STARCH, SUGAR, SALT, 2) SQUEEZE BOTTLES FOR OIL, WATER, ETC, 3) SHAKERS FOR SEASONINGS (SESEME SEEDS).
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS AND BOTTLES REQUIRE LABELS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food stored directly on the floor in the kitchen areas, walk-in refrigerator, walk-in freezer, and employee only closet.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT NOTHING SHALL BE DIRECTLY STORED ON THE FLOOR. PROVIDE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS AND MORE SHELVING AS NEEDED TO GET ALL FOOD OFF THE FLOOR BY 6 INCHES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL WET TOWELS SHALL BE STORED IN A RED BUCKET CONTAINING A BLEACH WATER SOLUTION AT 50-200PPM (TEST USING THE TEST STRIPS). THE GREEN BUCKETS ARE FOR SOAPY WATER SOLUTIONS. EACH WORK STATION MAY HAVE BOTH A GREEN AND RED BUCKET BUT AT LEAST A RED BUCKET FOR SANITIZER WATER. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) MEASURING CUPS LYING IN THE BULK BINS OF FOODS IN THE KITCHEN, 2) FOOD SCOOPS LYING IN THE BULK BINS OF FOODS, 3) RICE CUPS LYING IN THE BULK BINS OF DRY RICE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL BULK FOODS SHALL BE DISPENSED USING A UTENSIL DESIGNED WITH A HANDLE. THE HANDLE OF THE UTENSIL SHALL SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD AT ALL TIMES AND BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED EVERY DAY. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed cleaned and sanitized equipment stored on shelves above the 3-vat sink. They were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS THAT CONTACT TCS FOODS SHALL BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED EVERY 4 HOURS WHEN IN USE AND HAVE CONTACT TIME OF AT LEAST 10 SECONDS WITH THE BLEACH WATER SOLUTION BEFORE BEING AIR DRIED. DO NOT STACK EQUIPMENT WHILE WET. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Observed the following manufacturer containers being reused for other food storage: 1) SEAWEED SALAD CONTAINERS, 2) COMMERCIAL MAYONNAISE CONTAINERS, 3) COMMERCIAL TERIYAKI SAUCE CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCONTINUE THE REUSE OF THE ABOVE LISTED MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. THEY ARE NOT DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING. PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS FOR FOOD STORAGE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed only one Rheem tankless water heater installed at the facility. The Plans and pre-occupancy inspection stated they needed at least two tankless water heaters.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO CONTACT THEIR LICENSED CONTRACTOR TO INSTALL THE SECOND TANKLESS WATER HEATER IN PARALLEL WITH THE EXISTING UNIT. THE CONTRACTOR WILL NEED TO GET PERMITS FOR THIS INSTALLATION AS THE UNIT IS GAS. THIS WAS ASKED FOR CORRECTION DURING THE PRE-OCCUPANCY INSPECTION AND TO BE COMPLETED BEFORE THIS FIRST ROUTINE INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP ON 1/23/2026.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at kitchen hand sink to dispose of paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE A SMALL TRASH CAN UNDER THE KITCHEN HAND SINK BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. QUICKWAY JAPANESE HIBACHI (Inspection Date: 01/13/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, In Designated Room/Area
violations.observation: Observed no wall hooks or lockers provided for staff as requested during the pre-occupancy inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Provide lockers and/or personal storage facilities to prevent the potential contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, linens, or single-service items. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO INSTALL WALL HOOKS OR LOCKERS IN THE EMPLOYEE ONLY CLOSET BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
